subject: Marketplace listing: integration checklist and lead routing
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@awspartners.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-09T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: CloudRise listing — initial tech checklist and lead routing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro — excited to get CloudRise listed in the marketplace and understand the co-sell flow. We put together a short list of items we need to get the listing live and ensure leads route to your sales team correctly:

- Evidence for SKU metering and trial entitlements (billing + metering contact)
- API endpoints for telemetry (consent & PII notes)
- Lead routing: who owns inbound marketplace leads and HubSpot mapping
- Co-sell enablement: joint collateral + sales playbook sync

I've attached our marketplace intake form and a sample lead-routing CSV. Can we set a 30-min technical/ops sync today or tomorrow to go over the checklist?

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Partner Programs — AWS Marketplace
Maria.Gonzalez@awspartners.com

Attachment: cloudrise_marketplace_intake.pdf (stub)

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@awspartners.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-09T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudRise listing — initial tech checklist and lead routing

Hi Maria — thanks, this looks straightforward. I'm copying Ben (partnerships) and Vivek (platform/integrations) so we can align on the technical pieces and lead flow.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide metering proofs and an export of entitlements (need a PO or trial SKU mapping).
- Telemetry endpoints: we require an allowlist for ingest; Vivek will share the secured webhook spec.
- Lead routing: by default leads come into HubSpot; we support a marketplace-to-HubSpot mapping via a webhook or SFTP. Ben, do we want marketplace leads to route to the AE queue or partner success first?

I attached our internal marketplace evidence checklist and a suggested lead-routing matrix (CSV).

If Maria/Kevin are available, let's do 30 mins at 1:00pm PT today — otherwise tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: marketplace_evidence_checklist.xlsx (stub), lead-routing-matrix.csv (stub)

> If Maria/Kevin are available, let's do 30 mins at 1:00pm PT today — otherwise tomorrow morning.

I can take marketplace lead routing and mapping. Prefer AE queue for qualified leads; PS/partner success for trials and POC requests. Action items for me:
- Confirm HubSpot owner field mapping (will add column to the CSV).
- Make a simple playbook (1-pager) for partner-sourced leads to hand off to AE.

Ben

Thanks all — 1pm PT works for me. A couple quick notes before the call:
- We do have a compliance pack (SOC2 summary + data retention policy) that we can share — that should help with the telemetry/PII ask.
- For metering: we want the ability to issue limited trial entitlements (14d) triggered from the marketplace purchase flow. Is Redwood able to provision trial SKUs programmatically?

Also looping in our commercial lead, Maria (not AWS Maria) — maria@cloudrise.com — who will own co-selling logistics from our side.

Date: 2026-09-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: marketplace sync outcomes and next steps

Notes from 1:00pm PT sync with CloudRise + AWS: (quick capture)

- Technical: Webhook-based lead delivery accepted. Auth: HMAC-SHA256 header + allowlist IP. Example payload attached to internal repo (link posted to #partners).
- Trials: Redwood will support programmatic 14-day trial SKU provisioning. Ops needs: a trial SKU table + simple API call (POST /api/v1/entitlements) documented.
- Metering evidence: CloudRise to mail SOC2 summary and sample invoices. Finance asked for sku->metering mapping; Ben will own.
- Lead routing: partner leads flagged as "partner_syndicate" in HubSpot; flow: Partner Success triage -> AE qualification -> AE opportunity. Ben to implement mapping and provide test records.
- Collateral: co-branded one-pager + playbook. Olga to draft partner-facing playbook and drop in shared Drive.

Action owners and ETA:
- Ben: HubSpot mapping + test records (ETA: 2026-09-13)
- Vivek: webhook spec + sample payload (ETA: today close-of-day)
- Olga: playbook draft + go-to-market bullets (ETA: 2026-09-15)
- CloudRise (Kevin): SOC2 summary + metering samples (ETA: 2026-09-11)

I'll open the HubSpot deal RBW-5421 with test records and tag everyone. If any of you need me to escalate runtime access for test entitlements, ping me directly.

— Vivek
Director, Platform Integrations, Redwood Inference
